title: Märkische Projekt Bau – A Professional Web Presence for a Construction Company
excerpt: How we built and continue to manage the website for Märkische Projekt Bau, a construction company with over 20 years of experience in Berlin and Brandenburg.

blocks.text: Märkische Projekt Bau GmbH has been delivering construction projects across Berlin and Brandenburg since 1999. From structural work and carpentry to turn-key construction and heritage restoration, they bring over two decades of hands-on experience to every project.
They needed a website that reflected their professionalism and made it easy for potential clients to understand their full range of services.

Construction companies often struggle with their online presence. The industry is built on relationships and reputation, and many firms underinvest in their websites. Märkische Projekt Bau wanted to change that — they needed a site that clearly communicated their capabilities across structural work, carpentry, interior finishing, industrial construction, and heritage restoration.
The target audience includes property developers, architects, and private clients in the Berlin-Brandenburg region who search for reliable construction partners online.

We created a clean, professional website that showcases Märkische Projekt Bau's full service portfolio. Each service area — from Rohbau to Denkmalschutz — has dedicated content explaining their approach and qualifications.

The site is built with performance and SEO in mind. Fast load times, structured data, and clear content hierarchy help the company appear in local search results when potential clients look for construction services in their region.
We also implemented a straightforward contact flow, making it easy for interested parties to reach the team directly.

Beyond the initial build, we continue to manage and maintain the website. Content updates, technical maintenance, and performance monitoring are handled as part of an ongoing partnership — allowing the Märkische Projekt Bau team to focus on what they do best: building.

"Sebastian built and continues to manage our website, providing reliable support for several years. His consistent quality and dependability have been essential for our online presence." — S. Kundoch, Engineer at Märkische Projekt Bau
